method: Actual TypeScript stripped and imported in isolated memory; copy-on-write actions; synthetic fixtures and simulated signed owner only. No live data, network delivery, AI accounting judgment or scheduler execution tested.

tests.name: Untrusted ingestion and activation are rejected without changing state
Signup routes one Sales inquiry, creates no client/tasks and records no LAPS sale
Inquiry claim and triage do not grant commercial acceptance
Owner activation atomically records registry, terms and five scoped tasks
Exact activation retry is idempotent; conflicting acceptance is rejected atomically
Prerequisites cannot be claimed before their exact dependencies finish
Routine intake completes on receiving-role acceptance without financial approval
Missing originals block Sources even after receiving-role acceptance
Generic document creation cannot bypass the engaged-client Coordinator claim
Upload/reply ingestion is idempotent and does not imply source verification
Verification requires claimed Document Coordinator scope; open receipts still block
Accounting readiness retains judgment and exact Production acceptance
Production correction needs fresh independent review and exact owner release
Client Success must reference the exact released dependent Production packet
Delivery outbox preserves approved original, authorization, receipt and authorship
Portal delivery rejects missing routine portal authority
Pending dispatch locks supersession and human/technical review changes
Pending dispatch also locks task status changes
Upstream rework cannot reuse an old routine artifact and accepted handoff
Late original receipt invalidates downstream readiness before another publication
A late receipt waits behind a pending delivery snapshot then reopens source review
Idempotent task/document/deliverable keys reject conflicting scope and content
Existing task keys reject changed dependencies and delivery policy
Cross-client and cross-month dependencies are rejected
Claim conflicts, revision checks and scope checks protect task and inbox work
Expired claims deny mutations and can be reclaimed by another run
Source file binding rejects wrong client, wrong month and missing original
WIP cap is shared by inbox items and tasks, with release enabling next claim
Recurring periods create exactly one new closed-month task graph
Nonrecurring engagement does not automatically add new periods
100 isolated clients route and deduplicate requests, originals and replies
Full isolated journey finishes all five tasks with claims and separate role work
Concurrent activation persists both engagements and five-task graphs through actual SQL store
Concurrent SQL claims preserve exactly one task owner run
Concurrent conflicting commercial acceptance commits one coherent engagement
